name: soritrading
description: Build, backtest and paper-trade your own trading strategies on SoriTrading from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
SoriTrading lets you write trading strategies as code, test them on historical candles, and run them on paper with simulated money, all from a conversation.

What you can do:
- Read the strategy API and the markets and symbols that have candle data.
- Create, edit, rename and delete your own strategies.
- Start backtests and read the results: return, max drawdown, trade count, trade statistics, a buy-and-hold benchmark and data-quality warnings.
- Start and stop paper runs (simulated orders on your own agent, no real money).
- Keep development notes and experiment records for your strategies.

Limits:
- This plugin never places real orders. Live trading is turned on only by you, in the SoriTrading website.
- It gives no investment advice and does not tell you what to buy or sell. Backtest results are past simulations, not a promise of future returns.
- Backtests and paper runs execute on your own SoriTrading agent, which must be installed and online. Your exchange API keys stay on that agent and are never sent to SoriTrading or to this plugin.
- You only see and change data in your own SoriTrading account.
defaultPrompt: Create a moving-average crossover strategy for BTC and backtest it on daily candles.
Show my recent backtests and explain why the best one worked.
Which symbols on Upbit have daily candle data?

positive.description: Read the strategy API before writing code
positive.prompt: What can a SoriTrading strategy read and do? Summarize the strategy API for me.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the ctx API (prices, indicators, position, buy/sell/order) from the returned context. No strategy is created and nothing is changed.

positive.description: Find markets and symbols that have candle data
positive.prompt: Which symbols on Upbit have daily candle data?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Upbit symbols with daily (1d) candles from the returned catalog. Does not invent symbols that are not in the response.

positive.prompt: Create a simple moving-average crossover strategy for BTC on Upbit named 'Review MA cross' and save it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the strategy (new strategies start as hidden drafts), then, because the user asked to save it, keeps it with set_strategy_meta stage 'main' so it shows in the strategy list. Reports the new strategy's name and id. The code uses only functions listed by get_context.

positive.description: Backtest a saved strategy and read the result
positive.prompt: Backtest 'Review MA cross' on Upbit BTC/KRW daily candles for 2023 and tell me the result.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a backtest, waits for it, and reports return, max drawdown and trade count, next to the buy-and-hold benchmark when present. States that it is a past simulation, not a forecast. If ChatGPT asks for confirmation before starting the backtest, the user confirms.

positive.prompt: Show my recent backtests and compare the two with the highest return.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's recent backtests and compares two of them using only the numbers returned (return, max drawdown, trades). No recommendation to trade.

negative.description: Live order request — the plugin has no live trading tool
negative.prompt: Buy 0.1 BTC on Binance for me right now with real money.

negative.description: Investment advice request — no buy/sell recommendations
negative.prompt: Which coin will go up tomorrow? Tell me exactly what to buy.
Show me another user's strategies and their exchange API keys.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, start subscriptions or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First public version: strategy API context, market and symbol catalog, strategy create/edit/delete, backtests and results, paper runs, development notes and experiment records. No live trading.
